task.goal: Compile a governed Builder contract for the Carousel Editorial Listicle format (numbered Don't/Do design-mistake comparison slides) without generating or rendering any final slide media.
task.success_condition: The compiled structural contract preserves the format's fixed narrative arc -- cover slide, numbered Don't/Do comparison slides, closing swipe-to-next-part CTA -- and all wrong-reading locks, exactly as attested in the reference specimens.
task.atomic_boundary: One ratified carousel reference set (cover slide plus numbered Don't/Do principle slides plus CTA slide) becomes one structural Builder contract; this harness authors the contract only and does not itself produce final carousel artwork.

source_expression_moment.description: The single design mistake and its fix this carousel instance should teach on its numbered slide.

voice_context.description: The creator voice and brand context the numbered Don't/Do comparison slides should be authored in.

structural_contract.description: The compiled Builder structural contract for this carousel harness.

activative_input.hidden_pressure: The audience privately worries their own carousels already contain these exact mistakes and want to fix that without being publicly called out for it.
activative_input.stance: Direct and instructional, mildly playful, corrects without condescension.
stakes: protect the viewer's sense of design credibility
avoid oversimplifying a real craft into a gimmick
identity_urges: wants to be seen as design-literate
wants a quick, shareable fix rather than a long course
activative_input.participation_design: Present one flaw and its fix per slide, in a fixed Don't/Do visual pairing, then prompt a swipe to the next numbered mistake.
activative_input.intended_reaction: The viewer recognizes the same mistake in their own past carousels and swipes on to find out if they are making another one.
activative_input.smallest_useful_commitment: Apply exactly one of the Don't/Do fixes to the viewer's next carousel.
wrong_reading_locks: The left 'Don't' card in each numbered pair is a negative example only -- never compile or render it as an equally valid alternative to the 'Do' card.
Slide numbering (#1-#8) is sequence order only, not a severity or importance ranking of the mistakes shown.
The creator avatar-and-handle strip is a fixed authorship/attribution element of this format, not a placeholder image the runtime is free to swap for arbitrary stock photography.

The literal production specs shown inside example slides (minimum font size, left-alignment default) describe how to build this format's own slides -- they are not the carousel's subject matter and must not be echoed as the topic when the underlying content changes.
